answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake before it can act as a beacon for others. To forge many identities, an attacker must lock separate stakes for each one and keep them locked while peers verify work. If an identity cheats or duplicates a sonnet-like proof text, its stake is slashed. Honest agents recover theirs, but a sybil farm loses capital on every fake account, making mass creation more expensive than any reward it can extract.
